name: application-data-grid-cell-editor
title: Data Grid Cell Editor
description: A spreadsheet-style table with an inline-editable active cell, a dirty-cell highlight for unsaved edits, and a status footer for keyboard navigation hints.
useWhen: Users need to edit values directly inside table cells, spreadsheet-style, rather than through a separate form or modal.
Unsaved per-cell edits need a visible marker before the row or grid is saved.
Keyboard-first navigation between cells (arrow keys, Enter to edit) is a requirement.
avoidWhen: The table is read-only or edits always happen in a row-level form — use the plain `tables` component instead.
You need sorting, filtering, or pagination as the primary interaction — reach for `DataTable` and add cell editing only if the grid also needs it.
responsiveBehavior: The grid scrolls horizontally inside its own container below the width needed for all columns; keep the row-index column fixed-width so it doesn't compress.
accessibility: The active cell's inline input is keyboard-reachable and submits or cancels via standard Enter/Escape conventions in a real implementation.
Dirty cells are marked with both a background tint and a dot indicator, not color alone, and the footer states the count of unsaved changes in text.
The active-cell ring uses a 2px outline with sufficient contrast against both the cell and page background.

variants.title: Editable grid
variants.description: A 4-row product grid with one cell in active edit mode (ringed input) and one cell showing a dirty/unsaved highlight.
accessibility: The footer states the unsaved-change count and navigation hint as visible text, not solely as an icon.

variants.title: Editable grid (Dark)
variants.description: Editable grid adapted for dark surfaces, with the dirty highlight and active-cell ring re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: The active-cell ring and dirty-cell tint both meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark grid background.
